sections.content:
Looking at the ascii:
Row 20: `bbppccccggcccc` - p is at cols 14-15, then c (charcoal) at 16-19, g at 20-21, c at 22-25
Row 22: `ppppbbbbccbbbb` - p is at cols 12-15, then b (blue) at 16-19, c at 20-21, b at 22-25
So in rows 20-21, p is blocked RIGHT by c (charcoal robot parts). But in rows 22-23, there's b (blue) to the right, which is empty space.
So p can move RIGHT through rows 22-23 but is blocked in rows 20-21. This means p can navigate around the robot by going through the lower rows.
But wait, p is a connected object spanning rows 20-23. When I press RIGHT, the whole p object tries to move right. If any part is blocked, the whole thing might not move.
Let me look at the shape of p more carefully:
- Rows 20-21: pp at cols 14-15 (narrow part)
- Rows 22-23: pppp at cols 12-15 (wide part)
So p is L-shaped or has a wider bottom. The narrow part (rows 20-21) is blocked by c, but the wide part (rows 22-23) has b to the right.
Since p moved from col 10 to col 12 (2 columns) over 5 RIGHT actions, it seems like p moved once and then got blocked. The 5 actions might have been: 1 successful move (2 cols) + 4 blocked moves (0 cols each, but M moved instead).
So p is now blocked RIGHT by the robot's c parts. To get past the robot, I need to either:
1. Move p DOWN so it's below the robot entirely, then RIGHT
2. Find another way around
Let me check if p can move DOWN further. G is at [24,12]-[25,15], and rows 26+ are all blue (empty). So p/G should be able to move DOWN.
Let me try DOWN to get below the robot, then RIGHT toward B.
